scope: Read-only single-snapshot liveness triage for the local Codex game-host agent; downstream application of MoonWake canonical execution-boundary semantics, not a replacement generic controller or an effect permit.
parent: Maintain explicitly supplied BetterInstincts parent objective until evidenced acceptance or genuine terminal authority/access/safety gate.

input.operator_gameplay_permission: boolean; prior task intent only; not a per-effect permit

offline_work.action: specific bounded read-only engineering action, optional

rules: No time limit, narrative report, checked box or paused Sims game proves mission complete
Player active/unknown or protected/unknown save means zero game effects, even with gameplay permission
Screen/game effect always rechecks fresh dual idle probes, scene/PID/save/target and effect-authority independently; this CLI never grants or executes that permit
If P08 local game effect is blocked, continue available independent engineering work; do not claim the entire Sixth Gear group blocked
Unavailable host requires evidence; absent host proof is REOBSERVE_HOST or INVESTIGATE_NEXT_GATE, not a legitimate general terminal
Nonempty accepted completion evidence is required to close the parent; BI-002 hunger live certification needs its own independent 5+5 trial, rollback and patch receipt
All decisions are single-snapshot pure analysis; no daemon, timer polling, mouse/keyboard, game process control, saves, telemetry, host settings or filesystem writes
proof_ceiling: OFFLINE_CLASSIFICATION_ONLY; no agent stop-hook installation, host execution, game effect, gameplay certification or merge proof
